messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"It came to pass the second night that I saw a dream, and behold, an eagle which had twelve feathered wings and three heads came up from the sea.","verse":1,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of heaven blew on her, and the clouds were gathered together against her.","verse":2,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and out of her wings there grew other wings near them; and they became little, tiny wings.","verse":3,"chapter":11},{"text":"But her heads were at rest. The head in the middle was larger than the other heads, yet rested it with them.","verse":4,"chapter":11},{"text":"Moreover I saw, and behold, the eagle flew with her wings to reign over the earth and over those who dwell therein.","verse":5,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw how all things under heaven were subject to her, and no one spoke against her—no, not one creature on earth.","verse":6,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, the eagle rose on her talons, and uttered her voice to her wings, saying,","verse":7,"chapter":11},{"text":"“Don’t all watch at the same time. Let each one sleep in his own place and watch in turn;","verse":8,"chapter":11},{"text":"but let the heads be preserved for the last.”","verse":9,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, the voice didn’t come out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.","verse":10,"chapter":11},{"text":"I counted her wings that were near the others, and behold, there were eight of them.","verse":11,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, on the right side one wing arose and reigned over all the earth.","verse":12,"chapter":11},{"text":"When it reigned, the end of it came, and it disappeared, so that its place appeared no more. The next wing rose up and reigned, and it ruled a long time.","verse":13,"chapter":11},{"text":"It happened that when it reigned, its end came also, so that it disappeared, like the first.","verse":14,"chapter":11},{"text":"Behold, a voice came to it, and said,","verse":15,"chapter":11},{"text":"“Listen, you who have ruled over the earth all this time! I proclaim this to you, before you disappear,","verse":16,"chapter":11},{"text":"none after you will rule as long as you, not even half as long.”","verse":17,"chapter":11},{"text":"Then the third arose, and ruled as the others before, and it also disappeared.","verse":18,"chapter":11},{"text":"So it went with all the wings one after another, as every one ruled, and then disappeared.","verse":19,"chapter":11},{"text":"I saw, and behold, in process of time the wings that followed were set up on the right side, that they might rule also. Some of them ruled, but in a while they disappeared.","verse":20,"chapter":11}],"chapter":11,"book_code":"2ES"}
